script.title: अलक्ष्मी के लिए दरवाज़े पर नींबू-मिर्च क्यों टंगती है 🤯
script.hook_text: लक्ष्मी जी से पहले निकलीं अलक्ष्मी
sentences: मान्यता है, लक्ष्मी जी से पहले समुद्र मंथन से अलक्ष्मी निकलीं।
पद्म पुराण के मुताबिक़ अशुभ पहले निकलता है, शुभ बाद में।
नाम का मतलब है, जो लक्ष्मी नहीं।
देवताओं ने उन्हें बुरे लोगों में गरीबी और दुख बांटने भेजा।
कहते थे, वे जिस घर में आतीं, वहाँ भाई-भाई में फूट पड़ जाती।
उत्तर भारत के कई दरवाज़ों पर टंगे एक नींबू और सात हरी मिर्च उन्हीं के लिए हैं।
एक मान्यता है, यह खट्टी-तीखी गंध वे सह नहीं पातीं।
दूसरी मान्यता में उन्हें खट्टा-तीखा पसंद है, वे दरवाज़े पर हिस्सा लेती हैं, तब तक छोटी बहन लक्ष्मी अंदर आ जाती हैं।
यानी नींबू-मिर्च पहरा भी है, भेंट भी।
script.description:
समुद्र मंथन में लक्ष्मी जी से पहले कौन निकली थीं?
दरवाज़े पर नींबू-मिर्च की दो मान्यताएं।
visuals: Lemon and chillies hanging doorway India
claims_en: In belief, Alakshmi emerged before Lakshmi during the Samudra Manthana
According to the Padma Purana, the inauspicious emerges first and more effort creates the auspicious
Gods sent Alakshmi to dwell among pernicious persons and give them poverty and grief
It was said that when she entered a household, brothers fell out with each other
In Hindu households, especially in northern India, a lime and seven green chilies are hung at the doorstep as a ritual to ward off or acknowledge Alakshmi
One belief says the sour and pungent smell is something even Alakshmi cannot tolerate
Another belief says Alakshmi is pleased with sour and spicy offerings and receives her share at the door while her younger sister Lakshmi enters the home
scenes: Extreme close-up of a stern dark-complexioned goddess figure in black clothes, gaze piercing and solemn, emerging from churning ocean mist, dramatic moonlight, dignified and fully clothed
The cosmic ocean being churned with a great serpent wound around a mountain, devas and asuras pulling on either side, stormy sky, epic wide shot, painterly
Two sister goddesses side by side, Lakshmi radiant on a lotus in red and gold, Alakshmi in black beside her, contrasting light and shadow, dignified
Devas in a celestial court solemnly sending the goddess in black robes away toward a dark, quarrelsome town below, painterly
Inside an old North Indian home, two brothers turning away from each other in anger, a dim lamp between them, medium shot
Close-up of a lime and seven green chilies strung on a thread hanging at a wooden doorway of a North Indian house, morning light
The goddess in black stopping at the threshold, turning her face away from the lime and chilies, shadowy doorway, painterly
The goddess in black standing outside the door accepting the lime and chilies while radiant Lakshmi in red and gold steps gracefully inside the lamp-lit home, dignified
Wide shot of a village street at dusk, every door with a lime and chilies hanging, warm lamplight glowing from inside
